At the very top left corner, the title "Exercise 2 Solution" is written clearly. Below this heading, the first step begins by stating the equation: "Equation: $x^2 + 2x - 4x - 12 = x^2 - 2$". A solid underline extends beneath this line of text. Following this, Step 1 instructs to "Square both sides of the equation to eliminate the square root," followed by the algebraic manipulation "$x^2 - 2x^2 - 4x - 12 = (x^2 - 2)^2$". In Step 2, the expansion of the squared term is shown as "$x^2 + 2x^2 - 4x - 12 = x^2 - 4x + 4$". Step 3 proceeds to "Rearrange the equation to set it equal to zero," resulting in "$x^2 - 6x + 4 = 0$".
